content:
mateo_garcia: Heads-up — AcmeAI onboarding goes live tomorrow 09:00 UTC. We need expedited GPU + ENI quota lifts in me-central-1 (new account): p5 family for low-latency gen, g5 for batch. AWS case 1234567891 opened. Can infra help escalate?
priya_kapoor: Which account ID and current quotas? numbers pls.
alex_chang: Also note we need EFA/ENI limits raised, not just instance count. AWS sometimes denies if ENI/sec or ENIs-per-subnet are low. I'll loop in partner rep.
jordan_leung: If me-central-1 is delayed we should have fallback in eu-west-2 — is cross-region routing acceptable for this customer SLO?
sre_bot: Reminder: last ENI saturation event (ap-south-1, 2025-11-12) caused 4h degradation. Please include subnet-level ENI asks.
mateo_garcia: Account: 987654321098. Current quick snapshot: p5 quota = 0, g5 quota = 4, ENI quota (region) = 80, EFA ENIs = 20. Target ask: p5 -> 24, g5 -> 40, ENI region -> 2,000, EFA ENIs -> 200. Rationale: dedicated prod pool (3x p5) + burst batch cluster + canary capacity. Business justification attached to AWS case.
priya_kapoor: ok that sounds reasonable. Add cost estimate and signal from sales that ACME will be billed for reserved capacity. I can approve the wording.
mateo_garcia: Commands I ran to collect quotas:
```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A
aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings --location-type availability-zone --filters Name=instance-type,Values=p5.48xlarge
```
alex_chang: Pinged partner rep @jonah_aws. Also send them projected steady-state vCPU and expected sustained throughput to justify p5 counts.
aws_support: From AWS Case 1234567891: we've provisionally increased to p5 -> 20, g5 -> 30, ENI -> 150 while the capacity team reviews. ETA 12-18h for final approval. For expedite please provide ARNs for the EC2 roles, expected start time (UTC), and the customer business justification.
mateo_garcia: Adding ARNs and justification now in the case; requesting expedite due to 09:00 UTC onboarding.
priya_kapoor: Approved language. Also please note cost owner: @alex_chang — we will track consumption to avoid surprises.
jordan_leung: Created internal fallback plan and routing note: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-quota-escalation — use smart-routing to eu-west-2 if quotas not honored by T-6h.
sre_bot: I'll set a watch on ec2.quota_utilization.me-central-1 and alert at >70%. Also will post if any ENI metrics spike.
alex_chang: :thumbsup: I'll chase the partner rep and update case. If AWS keeps limits lower, we can carve dedicated dedicated-dedicated pool in eu-west-2 for the first 48h.
mateo_garcia: Thanks all — I'll update thread with AWS case replies. Please react or ping me directly if you want to own the follow-up.
priya_kapoor: :eyes: will monitor.
aws_support: Case update: capacity team requested confirmation on AZ distribution and subnet IDs to reserve ENI headroom. Reply with the subnet IDs in the case comments to speed approval.
mateo_garcia: Subnet IDs added. Marking as high priority in the case.
alex_chang: Noted. If we get provisional increases, start instance warmup (kernel modules + KV cache) to avoid cold-start CPU spikes. Small checklist in runbook.
jordan_leung: copy.
sre_bot: Monitoring rule created and a pager if quota_utilization > 85% during rollout window.
mateo_garcia: Closing the loop here once AWS confirms. Thanks everyone. :pray:
